answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23904 Country: India Title: Can we read surah Fatiha in (Qiyam) sirri salah or third or fourth rakah in other salat? Question: can we read surah Fatiha in (Qiyam) sirri salah or third or fourth rakah in other salat. Answer ID: 23904 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1334/1070/B=1431) According to the Hanafi Fiqh, it is not lawful to recite Surah Fatihah behind the Imam. Almighty Allah says in the holy Quran: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُواْ لَهُ وَأَنصِتُواْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ [الأعراف : 204] When the Qur'an is recited, listen to it and be silent, so that you may be blessed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
